scope: Runner-only explicit diagnostic GPU policy; no C/backend/loader/window implementation or OS settings changes.

options.--allow-gpu-submit: Default false. Explicit opt-in must be paired with --with-window. Window alone does not enable submission.
options.--gpu-budget-mib: Integer diagnostic budget256..4096MiB inclusive, default2048. Validated even when submission is off; only applied to child on explicit opt-in.

direct_API: run(args) validates GPU options before work/filesystem/process operations. getattr defaults allow existing Namespace callers without the new fields. CLI independently validates with the same helper before run.

child_environment.default: No TOTK_GPU_ALLOW_SUBMIT, TOTK_GPU_BUDGET_MB, TOTK_GPU_KEEPALIVE or TOTK_PROBE_GPU are inherited or sent. Existing backend nogpu() keeps actual game submission off.
child_environment.reason: Allow the real existing backend command submission only when requested, bound diagnostic memory, and disable auxiliary keepalive spin kernels during bring-up.
child_environment.isolation: Known explicit child environment, fresh owned run, separate HOME/TMP/config/cache/profile/saves/logs and existing proof validation remain unchanged. No environment is written globally.

receipt.gpu_submit_requested: Explicit user/runner option, not evidence of an actual command buffer or frame.
receipt.diagnostic_gpu_budget_mib: Validated requested setting, recorded even when not applied.
receipt.gpu_budget_applied_to_child: True only with explicit submission opt-in.
receipt.gpu_keepalive_disabled_by_runner: True only on explicit GPU runs; the child receives0.

existing_backend_reference: third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_mtl.m:nogpu() checks TOTK_GPU_ALLOW_SUBMIT/TOTK_PROBE_GPU and otherwise disables real game command submission.
Same backend GPU budget helper reads TOTK_GPU_BUDGET_MB; GPU keepalive startup returns early for TOTK_GPU_KEEPALIVE=0. Source was only read, not modified.
